name: promisetaxis
description: WhatsApp-based tuktuk hailing and dispatch for Copán Ruinas, Honduras

scripts.demo:verify: node demo/bundle.mjs harness demo/verify-phase1.ts demo/dist/verify-phase1.mjs && node demo/dist/verify-phase1.mjs
scripts.demo:verify:map: node demo/bundle.mjs harness demo/verify-phase3.ts demo/dist/verify-phase3.mjs && node demo/dist/verify-phase3.mjs
scripts.demo:verify:slots: node demo/bundle.mjs harness demo/verify-phase4.ts demo/dist/verify-phase4.mjs && node demo/dist/verify-phase4.mjs
scripts.demo:verify:hour: node demo/bundle.mjs harness demo/verify-phase5.ts demo/dist/verify-phase5.mjs && node demo/dist/verify-phase5.mjs
scripts.demo:verify:handout: node demo/bundle.mjs harness demo/verify-phase6.ts demo/dist/verify-phase6.mjs && node demo/dist/verify-phase6.mjs
scripts.db:migrate:staging: wrangler d1 migrations apply tuktuk --env staging --remote
scripts.db:migrate:prod: wrangler d1 migrations apply tuktuk --env production --remote
scripts.db:reset: rm -rf .wrangler/state/v3/d1 && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
